title: Juicy Italian Cocoa Tiramisu
description: A creamy and rich Italian dessert made with custard powder and cocoa powder. This is a no-onion-no-garlic-friendly version of the classic Tiramisu.
instructions: Dip the ladyfingers into the coffee and cocoa mixture for about 3-5 seconds on each side.
Place a layer of ladyfingers in the bottom of a serving dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the granulated sugar, custard powder, and cocoa powder until well combined.
Pour the custard mixture over the ladyfingers in the serving dish.
Repeat the layers of ladyfingers and custard mixture until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of custard on top.
In a separate bowl, mix together the mascarpone cheese, egg yolks, and whipped cream until well combined.
Spread the mascarpone mixture over the top layer of custard.
Melt the unsalted butter and brush it over the top of the mascarpone mixture.
Refrigerate the Tiramisu for at least 3 hours or overnight before serving.
